summary: Iteration 3: tested the light-theme UI, the 5 new detection scenarios, the Scenario Library, ingest for new domains, the AR case AI draft, and role and workflow regression. BACKEND 42/42 PASS: new test_new_domains.py 15/15, regression test_leakage_api.py 21/21 (send_claim passed this run, no 429) and test_pending_access.py 6/6. GET /api/domains returns 10 domains, each with a group and description, in 3 groups. Templates for all 5 new domains download, and their columns match /api/domains. Seeded cases exist for every new domain with the expected leak types: AR has SHORT_PAYMENT, UNPAID_OVERDUE, UNEARNED_DISCOUNT and LATE_INTEREST. AP has OVERPAYMENT and DUPLICATE_BILLING. SaaS has SEAT_OVERBILLING, processing has PROCESSING_OVERCHARGE and royalty has ROYALTY_SHORTFALL. For every checked case, leak_amount equals the sum of the over/under variances. Hand-checked cases: SaaS CS-2026-10 (25 excess seats x 45 = 1125, plus 240 x (49-45) = 960, total 2085), royalty Q3 (6% x 940k = 56,400 - 47,000 = 9,400) and processing (400 over). AR CSV ingest on a TEST_ customer: 10000 paid 9000 on time gave SHORT_PAYMENT 1000. Empty amount_paid and payment_date with a past due date gave UNPAID_OVERDUE (principal + 1.5%/month interest). A clean row produced no case. 2% taken after the window gave UNEARNED_DISCOUNT 200. AP: the same vendor_invoice_no paid twice gave DUPLICATE_BILLING 1000, and 2300 paid on a 2000 invoice gave OVERPAYMENT 300. FRONTEND: every page is light themed with no dark leftovers: landing, sign-in (Clerk light), Control Tower, scenarios, leakages, case detail, pipeline, ingest, contracts and rule dialog, assurance, copilot, audit, admin (3 tabs and counterparty dialog), the pending page, the notification popover and the action dialogs. Scenario Library shows 3 groups and 10 scenario-card-* cards with Found and Recovered amounts. Clicking the AR card opens /app/leakages?domain=AR_RECEIVABLE with 12 rows, all AR. On the AR case, the under-received variance shows in red (rose-600). ai-email-generate-button streamed a collection-style email (256 chars, then 1415). Full approver flow in the UI on the TEST_ case worked: start review, approve, send claim (to delivered@resend.dev), then record a 400 recovery, which gave Partially recovered. The UI ingest of an AR CSV with the template download worked (2 leaks, $7,794, math verified). Pending page shown and sign-out works. At 390px the mobile dashboard and mobile nav drawer work, but case detail overflows horizontally. ONE HIGH DATA BUG: duplicate sample counterparties.

critical.issue: The 6 new sample counterparties appear TWICE in db.counterparties, with identical ids: cp_northwind, cp_brightline, cp_apex, cp_cloudsuite, cp_paystream, cp_lumen (created at 09:43:06 and 09:43:14). The admin Counterparties tab lists each twice, and the ingest and rule counterparty selects get duplicate options with duplicate React keys. RCA: the first seed run failed (backend.err.log shows a traceback at seed.py line 246, the rules insert, during a hot reload). The counterparties were already inserted with insert_one, but settings.seed.cps is only updated at the end, so the next startup inserted them again. There is no unique index on counterparties.id. Rules, cases, transactions and batches are NOT duplicated.

minor.issue: The full unpaid principal counts as 'leakage' from the first day past due. Example: BL-INV-20951, 3 days overdue, gives a $37,087 HIGH case. Receivables make up about $219k of the $310k identified, which inflates the CFO KPI. Consider an overdue grace threshold (e.g. 30+ days) or reporting overdue principal as 'at-risk receivable' separate from leakage. Also, interest uses datetime.now() at detection time and is frozen on the case, so it never accrues afterwards.

Interest is calculated on the full net invoice even when most of it was paid (e.g. a short payment paid late). It should be calculated on the outstanding balance, or on the amount paid late, per typical terms.

The duplicate key is vendor_invoice_no only. Legitimate instalment payments against the same invoice (e.g. 50% + 50%) will be flagged DUPLICATE_BILLING for the full second payment. Compare cumulative amount_paid against invoice_amount instead.
The batches for the original 6 sample counterparties (freight, rebate, price, etc.) show '—' in the Leaks column, although cases exist for them. Their detection is null in db.batches.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow: scrollWidth is 419 at a viewport of 390. The header stat tiles (Leakage/Recovered/Window) don't wrap, so the Window tile is cut off, and the Calculation table's Variance column runs to the edge. Wrap the tiles (flex-wrap or a 2-column grid) and put the calculation table in overflow-x-auto.

issues: Secondary text uses slate-400 (#94a3b8) on white, a contrast of 2.56:1 (below WCAG AA 4.5:1). This affects sidebar group headings, dates, 'Unassigned', window days, eyebrow labels, term keys on contract cards and the 'Data:' line on scenario cards. Use slate-500 or slate-600.
Leakages table: the $0.00 recovered value uses slate-300, a contrast of 1.48:1, which is nearly invisible.
Landing hero card: the 'Contract' column values and the 'CASE LK-1031' label also use slate-400.
Effective from/to use the browser's native input type=date instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker.

action_items: HIGH: Make seed_if_empty idempotent. Upsert counterparties and rules by id (update_one with upsert=True), add unique indexes on counterparties.id and rules.id, and remove the 6 duplicate counterparty docs that are already in the DB. Keep one doc per id: delete by _id, keeping the earliest.
Fix the horizontal overflow on case detail at 390px (header tiles and calculation table).
Raise the contrast of slate-400/slate-300 secondary text to slate-500/600.
Replace the native date inputs in the rule editor with the shadcn Calendar date picker.
Consider an overdue grace threshold or a separate KPI for UNPAID_OVERDUE principal. Calculate interest on the outstanding amount. Handle instalment payments in the AP duplicate check.
Backfill the detection summary for the original sample batches, which show '—' in ingest history.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py: insert_one for counterparties and rules with completion marked at the end is not crash-safe. A partial run duplicates data on the next startup (this happened).
server.py creates a unique index only on cases.id. Counterparties, rules and batches have no unique id index.

engine.eval_receivable depends on wall-clock time (datetime.now()), so results are non-deterministic. Re-running detection on the same row on different days gives different amounts, while the assurance auto re-check runs on the same instant, so it always 'matches'.
engine.eval_saas: the seat-excess and unit-price lines overlap correctly (the total equals billed - billable x contract price). Verified.
routes_data.ingest handles NaN to None and empty dates correctly. Empty amount_paid and payment_date are classified as UNPAID_OVERDUE.

rca of the issue: Duplicate counterparties: seed_if_empty inserts todo counterparties with insert_one, then rules, transactions and detection, and only records completion in settings.seed.cps at the very end. During a hot reload at 09:43 the first run raised an exception at seed.py:246 after the counterparties were inserted. The next startup found the cps not marked done and inserted them again. Rules, transactions and cases were not duplicated (transaction row_hash dedupe, and cases.id is unique). Mitigation: upsert by id, add unique indexes, dedupe the existing docs.
